Nothing has shipped yet, William, and nothing has changed since we last spoke.

Your Harlo B30 is in batch 4 and ships the week of November 14. The free Power Kit goes out separately as soon as it lands at our warehouse, ahead of the B30, with its own tracking by email.

You can watch the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else you want me to check?
